title: Microsoft Copilot: delegated publishing of organisation prompts
summary: Hold: the briefing says cloud availability is unstated even though the roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant). It also calls prompt management portal-only without evidence that other routes are prohibited or unavailable; the documented admin path itself is correct.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls: table and final sentence
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented a Graph, PowerShell or other API equivalent for organisation prompt management.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" "API"', '"organizational prompts" "PowerShell"', 'site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "organizational prompts" publish'. Opened Learn /copilot/manage/organizational-prompts; no equivalent found.

claims.where: controls[1]; Governance controls: table; Open questions: first bullet
claims.claim: Learn does not yet document the control for delegating organisation prompt publishing on either the admin UI or API surface.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" "delegation"'; 'site:learn.microsoft.com/copilot "organization prompts" delegation admin'; API and PowerShell queries. Opened Learn /copilot/manage/organizational-prompts; no delegation control.

claims.claim: Prompt management is portal-only.
claims.quote: Searched: '"organizational prompts" "API"', '"organizational prompts" "PowerShell"', 'site:learn.microsoft.com/graph "organizational prompts" publish'. Opened Learn /copilot/manage/organizational-prompts; no statement of portal exclusivity.
claims.fix: Replace 'Prompt management is portal-only and role-gated' with 'Microsoft Learn documents role-gated prompt management in the admin centre; no Graph or PowerShell equivalent is documented at the time of writing (November 2026).' Absence of API documentation does not establish that no API exists.

claims.claim: Search Editor is a less privileged publishing option than AI Administrator.
claims.quote:
Users in this role can create, manage, and delete content for Microsoft Search in the Microsoft 365 admin center, including bookmarks, Q&As, and locations.
AI Administrator: This is a privileged role.
claims.fix: Cite the Microsoft Entra built-in roles reference at https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/role-based-access-control/permissions-reference#search-editor and #ai-administrator for the role-scope comparison. The Configure Copilot settings page does not state it.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published whether organisation prompt publishing delegation is audited.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed whether delegated organisation prompt edits are logged in Purview audit.

claims.where: Governance guidance: After rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: The checklist directs readers to review prompt analytics, but the controls table omits that control.
claims.quote:
Review prompt analytics for active users and submissions.
Controls: Creating, editing, importing and pinning organisation prompts; Delegating prompt publishing to other roles or people.
claims.fix: Add a 'Reviewing organisation prompt analytics' control row with the Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Prompts location and Active users and Submissions metrics. Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/organizational-prompts#review-analytics-for-organizational-prompts; no API was found.

claims.where: front matter: action; front matter: defaultState
claims.claim: The prepare action rating conflicts with the standard for an optional administrator-configured capability.
claims.quote: action: "prepare"; defaultState: "admin-opt-in"; risk: "medium"; admins can grant prompt publishing to individual users, Microsoft Entra security groups and distribution groups.
claims.fix: Change action to 'review'. The standard assigns review to optional new controls that change nothing until an administrator chooses them; no source states that existing publishing changes without delegation, and the high-risk exception does not apply.

claims.claim: Delegated publishing is admin-opt-in because an administrator grants publishing authority to delegates.
claims.quote: Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts
